Search + agent-surface instrumentation

24h of production PostHog showed four auto events and zero custom ones: "Search" clicked 3 times, nothing about what was typed or clicked. Meanwhile ~4K edge requests were invisible to both sinks. Toggle below to see the volume bugs the adversarial verifier caught between those two facts.

Which requests emit an agent event?

RequestAcceptEmitsVerdict

Why a non-HTML Accept is not an agent

gate was:   prefersJsonError(accept)  ==  !accept.includes("text/html")

  browser fetch()        sends  Accept: */*   -> passed
  navigator.sendBeacon   sends  Accept: */*   -> passed

fumadocs fetchClient issues a BARE fetch() with no headers,
debounced at 100ms  (node_modules/fumadocs-core/dist/search/client.js)

  => one agent:api-request per settled keystroke, from our own dialog
  => every first-party beacon minted a second, duplicate event

Found by running the middleware, not reading it. The client-side search:performed was correctly debounced at 1500ms the whole time; the middleware event sitting next to it was not.

Events shipped

search:performed
query (truncated 80), result_count, tag — 1500ms debounce, keyed on tag+query
search:result-clicked
query, url, position (zero-based), result_type, tag
search:zero-results
unchanged wire format, now through the same chokepoint
agent:api-request
surface, accept_family, ua_family, method
agent:not-found
the paths agents expect and we do not serve
agent:mcp-call
method, tool, is_error, result_count — one event per JSON-RPC request

position is the point of the exercise: it is how we tell whether the ranking fix in #3202 changed behaviour rather than just changing the numbers. The PostHog mirror receives query_length, never the raw query.

Why middleware, and not the route handlers

the 8 /.well-known/* handlers, /openapi.json, /llms.txt
  are `revalidate = false` + zero-arg GET()

  => they execute at BUILD time, then are CDN-served
  => any capture() inside them runs once, ever

middleware is the only server code that sees these requests at all.
